title: Private Compatibility Certification Lab & Pilot Gating - Q3 Roadmap
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Build a lightweight, repeatable Compatibility Certification Lab and a formal pilot-gating process for Private/VPC/on‑prem customer activations for Q3.

Scope:
- Automated compatibility checks (networking, KMS/HSM, model artifact validation, container runtime, OS/kernel checks).
- A test harness that can run customer repros (initially 3 seeded customers) against a replica of the Private control plane and on‑prem runtime images.
- Define pilot pass/fail gates, telemetry dashboards, and a runbook for rollbacks and emergency roll-forward.
- Create stakeholder playbooks for Solutions Engineering and CS to run pilots and report acceptance.

Out of scope for Q3: fully automated self-service certs for customers; long tail hardware variants beyond our 90th percentile coverage.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Certification lab can run the canonical customer validation suite end-to-end in < 4 hours for each seeded customer.
2) All tests in the compatibility matrix pass for the first pilot tenant (network/KMS/container/metrics).
3) Pilot gating checklist (security sign-off, perf SLOs, data handling) formalized and approved by Security and Legal.
4) Pilot telemetry dashboards show baseline latency, token cost delta, and error rate — all within agreed thresholds.
5) Solutions Eng has a documented 5-step playbook and runbook for activation/rollback.
success_metrics:
- 3 pilot customers certified to run Private in Q3 (pilot -> GA conversion target 60%).
- Mean time to certify a new customer reduced from 12 days to 3 days.
- No critical customer-impacting incidents in first 30 days post-pilot for certified customers.
- Regression alert rate reduced by 50% vs previous manual pilot process.
stakeholders: PM: Aisha Patel; Eng Leads: Liam Chen, Priya Rao; Security: Marco Silva; Solutions Eng: Tara Nguyen; Customer Success: David Morales
tradeoffs_and_notes:
- Tradeoff: investing in a lab and automated harness delays broader self-service certification; chosen because repeatable pilot success materially reduces enterprise risk.
- Chosen approach prioritizes 90th percentile hardware/network topologies rather than exhaustive coverage to keep Q3 deliverable realistic.
- We will use canary pilot cohorts (1 -> 2 -> 3) rather than parallel onboarding to limit blast radius.
technical_approach_summary:
1) Build a Docker/k8s-based lab orchestrator that can spin up a Private control-plane replica and runtime images in our test VPCs.
2) Integrate existing infra tests (ENG-8421) and extend with network/KMS smoke tests and a KV cache warmup profile.
3) Create an artifact validator that checks model files and quantization compatibility.
4) Publish an automated certification report (PDF + telemetry snapshot) to Drive/Confluence for sign-off.
risks:
- Risk: KMS/HSM integration variability across customers could produce false negatives; mitigation: include a KMS emulation mode and a documented manual verification step.
- Risk: long-running validation jobs could eat test capacity; mitigation: quota the lab and schedule off-peak runs.
- Risk: mismatch between lab and customer network egress patterns; mitigation: collect network traces during pilot and iterate lab network profiles.
qa_plan:
- Create 4 test suites: infra smoke, KMS handshake, model artifact validation, load/player replay.
- CI: Tests run nightly and on every change to private runtime images.
- Pre-pilot: run full suite for 3 seeded customers; pass required before gating.
- Post-pilot: monitor 7- and 30-day SLOs and run regression tests weekly.
rollout_plan:
Phase 0 (March): Finalize matrix + infra scaffolding.
Phase 1 (April): Implement lab orchestrator + smoke tests.
Phase 2 (May): Seed first pilot customer, iterate.
Phase 3 (June): Run two additional pilots, finalize gate criteria, prepare GA playbook.
Gates: Security sign-off, perf SLOs met, successful rollback drill completed.

notes_for_reviewers: Please review the acceptance criteria and security addenda in Confluence. Key decision request: approve KMS emulation as an interim mitigation (vs blocking pilot until full HSM parity).
customer_cohort: Customer A (finance, high-compliance), Customer B (healthcare), Customer C (SaaS scale).
observability_guardrails:
- Dashboard must include per-tenant 95th latency, token cost delta, error rate, and decision flag for gate pass/fail.
- Alerts: >2x error rate or >20% token cost delta triggers SE/CS paged review.
postmortem_plan: If a pilot fails post-activation, run a 5-whys, produce a remediation plan within 5 business days, and require re-certification before next pilot.
